text: {"assertions":["A NaN feature bug was discovered in ml/features/encoder.py on 2026-01-17 affecting the ML pipeline.","The NaN bug only appeared for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket.","The root cause was two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction.","The bug could be reproduced by encoding a batch holding the sparse column.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction, submitted as PR #1894 on branch fix/nan-feature-1.","After applying the fix, the job completed in 3 minutes instead of 4 hours.","This NaN bug occurred in the same region of ml/features/encoder.py as earlier NaN feature work."]}
